overview.purpose_zh: 迷你趋势线放在一个指标旁边，用一眼看懂方向和高低点，不提供刻度，也不指望你读出某一天的具体分钟数。
works_zh: 在卡片或表格里补一个趋势背景
提示工作日和周末的节奏

understanding.read_zh: 没有坐标轴时，先看整体往哪走，再看最高点和最低点差多少，最后看有没有规律的上下节奏。具体分钟数要点开数据或看旁边的指标值。

elements.note_zh: 一条没有刻度的细线，每个点是一天的屏幕时间。
最高点和最低点被标出来，方便一眼看到范围。
每周两天的凸起是周末，工作日则贴得较低。
横轴和纵轴都不标数字，所以只能读方向和相对高低。
迷你图通常跟一个当前值放在一起，那个数字才是精确值。

look_for_zh: 整体是向上、向下还是基本走平
每周是不是有固定的高低节奏

observations.en: The line drifts gently upward: it starts at 95 minutes and ends at 103.
observations.zh: 这条线缓慢向上：从 95 分钟开始，到 103 分钟结束。

observations.en: The lowest day is 84 minutes and the highest is 154, a range of 70.
observations.zh: 最低的一天是 84 分钟，最高的一天是 154 分钟，差距为 70。

observations.en: Weekdays stay between 84 and 114 minutes, while weekends sit between 124 and 154.
observations.zh: 工作日保持在 84 到 114 分钟之间，周末则在 124 到 154 分钟之间。

observations.en: A rough level is enough here: weekdays cluster near 100 minutes and weekends near 140.
observations.zh: 这里给出大致水平就够了：工作日集中在 100 分钟附近，周末在 140 分钟附近。

observations.en: Weekends run about 40 minutes above weekdays at both the top and the bottom of their ranges.
observations.zh: 无论看区间的上端还是下端，周末都比工作日高大约 40 分钟。

observations.en: The six-month rise is small next to the weekly swing: 8 minutes from first day to last, against a range of 70.
observations.zh: 六个月的上升相对每周波动很小：从第一天到最后一天只增加 8 分钟，而整体差距有 70 分钟。

observations.en: There is no sharp break or sudden jump; the same weekly pattern repeats from January to June.
observations.zh: 没有突然的断裂或跳升，同样的每周节奏从一月重复到六月。

describe.en: Screen time edged up from 95 minutes on January 1 to 103 on June 30.
describe.zh: 屏幕时间从一月一日的 95 分钟小幅上升到六月三十日的 103 分钟。
describe.pattern: edge up + to / by + small amount
alternatives: The line edged up by 8 minutes over six months.
Screen time ended slightly above its starting level.
describe.note_zh: edge up 专门表示小幅上升，适合这种缓慢漂移。

describe.en: The trend climbs gradually, with the weekly ups and downs much larger than the six-month change.
describe.zh: 趋势逐渐上升，每周的起伏比六个月的整体变化大得多。
alternatives: The line rises gradually across the six months.
The upward drift is gentle, not dramatic.
describe.note_zh: gradually 强调慢，不强调幅度；和 weekly 对比时很好用。

describe.en: The lowest point hit a low of 84 minutes on January 23.
describe.zh: 最低点在一月二十三日，跌到 84 分钟。
alternatives: January 23 is the lowest day, at 84.
describe.note_zh: hit a low of 后面直接接数值，日期用 on。

describe.en: The highest point reached a peak of 154 minutes on June 7.
describe.zh: 最高点在六月七日，达到 154 分钟。
describe.note_zh: peak 既可以作名词也可以作动词，这里用名词短语更稳。

describe.en: The line fluctuates between 84 and 154 minutes, mostly following the weekday and weekend rhythm.
describe.zh: 这条线在 84 到 154 分钟之间波动，主要跟随工作日和周末的节奏。
alternatives: The weekly pattern repeats with only small changes.
describe.note_zh: fluctuate between 后面接两个端点，不要接单一数值。

describe.en: Weekdays fall between 84 and 114 minutes, and weekends between 124 and 154.
describe.zh: 工作日在 84 到 114 分钟之间，周末在 124 到 154 分钟之间。
describe.note_zh: between ... and ... 和 from ... to ... 都能给区间，前者更强调范围。

describe.en: The general trend is a slight upward drift inside a strong weekly cycle.
describe.zh: 总体趋势是在强烈的每周周期里缓慢向上漂移。
describe.pattern: The general trend is + upward / downward / flat
alternatives: The general trend is gently upward.
The weekly cycle is stronger than the long-term trend.
describe.note_zh: 先给 general trend，再补 weekly cycle，主次就清楚了。

describe.en: Weekends are consistently higher than weekdays, by about 40 minutes at both ends of the range.
describe.zh: 周末始终高于工作日，在区间的两端都高大约 40 分钟。
alternatives: Weekend values are about 40 minutes above weekday values.
Every weekend sits higher than every weekday.
describe.note_zh: consistently 强调每次都成立，不是平均下来高。

academic.en: The sparkline summarizes daily screen time from January 1 to June 30, 2026. Owing to the absence of axis labels, only direction, relative level and rhythm may be stated; exact daily values are not recoverable from the line. A gentle upward movement is recorded, from 95 minutes on the first day to 103 on the last. A weekly cycle is superimposed on this movement: weekdays range from 84 to 114 minutes, whereas weekends range from 124 to 154. The minimum, 84 minutes on January 23 and the maximum, 154 on June 7, define a range of 70 minutes.
academic.zh: 这张迷你趋势线汇总了 2026 年一月一日至六月三十日的每日屏幕时间。由于图上没有坐标轴标签，只能陈述方向、相对高低与节奏，无法从线条读出精确的每日数值。整体呈现缓慢上行，从第一天的 95 分钟到最后一天的 103 分钟。周周期叠加在这一变化之上：工作日在 84 到 114 分钟之间，周末在 124 到 154 分钟之间。最低值 84 分钟出现在一月二十三日，最高值 154 分钟出现在六月七日，两者相差 70 分钟。

business.en: Our screen-time KPI sits beside this sparkline, and the weekly pattern is what matters to us: daily use runs from 84 to 154 minutes, with weekends about 40 minutes above weekdays. Our first day shows 95 minutes and our last shows 103, a rise of 8 that is small against the 70-minute range. For a wellbeing review, the conversation should be about weekend habits rather than a slow upward creep. We should focus our next review there.
business.zh: 我们的屏幕时间指标就放在这条迷你趋势线旁边，对我们来说真正重要的是每周节奏：每日使用时长在 84 到 154 分钟之间，周末比工作日高大约 40 分钟。我们的第一天是 95 分钟，最后一天是 103 分钟，增加 8 分钟，相对 70 分钟的区间来说很小。做健康回顾时，该谈的是周末习惯，而不是缓慢上移。我们下一次复盘就聚焦在那里。

simple.en: This little line shows daily screen time for six months. It climbs a little, from 95 minutes to 103. Day by day it stays between 84 and 154 minutes. Weekends are higher: about 40 minutes more than weekdays. The top day is 154 minutes in June, and the bottom day is 84 in January. There are no numbers on the axes, so the exact value comes from the KPI next to it.
simple.zh: 这条小线展示六个月里的每日屏幕时间。它略微上升，从 95 分钟到 103 分钟。每天的值在 84 到 154 分钟之间。周末更高，比工作日多大约 40 分钟。最高的一天是六月的 154 分钟，最低的一天是一月的 84 分钟。坐标轴上没有数字，所以精确值要看旁边的指标。

language_notes.body_zh: 没有刻度的图只能给大约数，配 about、roughly、around；有精确值时才用 exactly 或直接报数。两者混用会让听众以为迷你图能读出精确值。
examples: Weekends are about 40 minutes higher than weekdays.
The exact value for June 7 is 154 minutes.

language_notes.title_en: range from ... to ... vs between ... and ...
language_notes.body_zh: range from ... to ... 强调最低到最高这一段，between ... and ... 强调落在区间内。描述整段分布用前者，描述某类日子落在哪一段用后者。
drift up 是慢慢漂上去，jump 是突然跳一下。迷你图上的六个月变化只有 8 分钟，用 drift 或 edge up 才准确，用 jump 会夸张。
examples: Screen time drifted up by 8 minutes over six months.
There was no sudden jump; the weekly rhythm stayed the same.
